name: Vector XL Driver Library
notes: All Vector XL interfaces share vxlapi (vxlapi64.dll). Enumerate returns one entry per CAN-capable XL channel; FD capability is read from XL_CHANNEL_FLAG_CANFD_ISO / BOSCH.
